notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color that can only be spent to cast your commander.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
